verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a vendor API with OAuth2/PKCE auth that supports appending data to notes and returning bookmarked links, enabling some headless write access, but there's no MCP server and the read capability appears limited to specific data (bookmarks) rather than general note reading/querying, and probes confirm no OpenAPI/llms.txt discoverability for agents. Missing for 10: documented general read/query API for arbitrary notes, an MCP server or agent-specific integration, and evidence of real-world headless read/write usage by coding agents.
